title: One story
note: Written fresh on 2026-11-26 at James's word: "I want you to have liberty to write the scripts." Not recorded, and James has not read it yet. Every fact is listed with where to check it in facts.md beside this file. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, copied word for word from client/public/bible/text/; an exclamation mark appears only where the verse has one. Field names and `gap` follow James's description of the Gather scripts; match them to film/beliefs/script.json on the Mac.

lines: The Bible is sixty-six books, written by many authors over more than a thousand years.
It opens with God making a good world.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

scripture.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

lines: Then people decide they'd rather run it themselves. And everything cracks. With God, with each other, with the world itself.
God doesn't walk away. He chooses one family, Abraham's, and makes a promise.
All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.

scripture.text: all the families of the earth will be blessed through you

lines: The rest of the Old Testament follows that family. Rescued from slavery. Given a land. Ruled by kings. Carried into exile. And waiting.
Then the story does something no one saw coming. The author steps into it.
The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.
Jesus lives the life we didn't. He dies the death we earned. And he walks out of the grave.

scripture.text: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.

lines: The last page sounds like the first.
Behold, I make all things new.

scripture.text: Behold, I make all things new.

lines: You're living between those two pages. Find your place in the story.
titleCard: Find your place in the story.
